mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS project_id,p.version AS project_version,p.project_code,p.project_name,p.company_code,p.company_name,p.customer_code,p.customer_name,p.manager_employee_no,p.manager_name, COALESCE(v.scope_version,0) AS scope_version FROM proj_project p LEFT JOIN com_delivery_scope_project_version v ON v.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND v.project_id=p.id AND v.deleted=FALSE WHERE p.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND p.deleted=FALSE AND p.id IN #{id}AND 1=0 FOR UPDATE
SELECT id,source_evidence FROM com_delivery_scope WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND LEFT(source_evidence,30)='DPPMS:pm_project_product_line:' FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM com_delivery_scope WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND id IN #{id}AND 1=0 FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM com_delivery_scope_detail WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND delivery_scope_id IN #{key}AND 1=0 FOR UPDATE
SELECT id,code,name,version FROM system_dept WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND deleted=FALSE AND code IS NOT NULL AND code<>''
mapper.sql: JOIN int_base_sync_binding b ON b.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND b.target_id=s.id AND b.object_key='PRODUCT_SCOPE' AND b.deleted=FALSE JOIN int_base_sync_task t ON t.tenant_id=b.tenant_id AND t.id=b.task_id AND t.task_code='BASE_P22' AND t.connection_id=#{query.connectionId} AND t.deleted=FALSE AND t.active_run_id=b.last_run_id
mapper.update: UPDATE com_delivery_scope s JOIN system_dept d ON d.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND CAST(d.code AS BINARY)=CAST(s.department_code AS BINARY) AND d.deleted=FALSE AND d.id>0 AND d.version IS NOT NULL AND d.name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(d.name)<>'' AND (s.department_version IS NULL OR d.version=s.department_version) AND (s.department_name IS NULL OR CAST(d.name AS BINARY)=CAST(s.department_name AS BINARY)) SET s.department_id=d.id,s.update_time=s.update_time WHERE s.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND s.department_id=-1 AND s.deleted=FALSE AND s.allocation_source='DPPMS' AND s.department_code IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(s.department_code)<>''
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM com_delivery_scope s WHERE s.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND s.department_id=-1 AND s.deleted=FALSE AND s.allocation_source='DPPMS' AND s.department_code IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(s.department_code)<>'' AND (s.department_name IS NOT NULL OR s.department_version IS NOT NULL)

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema=DATABASE() AND table_name='com_delivery_scope' AND column_name IN ('department_code','department_name','department_version') AND is_nullable='YES'

SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.key_column_usage WHERE table_schema=DATABASE() AND table_name='com_delivery_scope' AND column_name='order_line_id' AND referenced_table_name IS NOT NULL)=0 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema=DATABASE() AND table_name='com_delivery_scope' AND column_name IN ('order_source_system','order_company_code','order_type') AND is_nullable='YES')=3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
mapper.sql:
FROM com_sales_order_line l JOIN com_sales_order o ON o.tenant_id=l.tenant_id AND o.id=l.order_id AND o.deleted=FALSE AND o.status='ENABLED' AND CAST(o.source_system AS BINARY)=CAST(l.source_system AS BINARY) AND CAST(o.company_code AS BINARY)=CAST(l.company_code AS BINARY) AND CAST(o.order_type AS BINARY)=CAST(l.order_type AS BINARY) AND CAST(o.order_no AS BINARY)=CAST(l.order_no AS BINARY) JOIN int_base_sync_binding ob ON ob.tenant_id=l.tenant_id AND ob.target_id=l.id AND ob.object_key='SALES_LINE' AND ob.deleted=FALSE
AND CAST(ob.source_key AS BINARY)=CAST(SHA2(CAST(JSON_ARRAY(l.source_system,l.company_code,CAST(l.line_type AS UNSIGNED),l.order_no,l.line_no) AS CHAR),256) AS BINARY) JOIN int_base_sync_task ot ON ot.tenant_id=ob.tenant_id AND ot.id=ob.task_id AND ot.task_code='BASE_P14' AND ot.connection_id=#{query.connectionId} AND ot.deleted=FALSE JOIN int_base_sync_run rr ON rr.tenant_id=ot.tenant_id AND rr.task_id=ot.id AND rr.connection_id=ot.connection_id AND rr.id=ob.last_run_id AND rr.task_code='BASE_P14' AND rr.status='COMPLETED' AND rr.preview=FALSE AND rr.deleted=FALSE WHERE l.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND l.deleted=FALSE AND l.status='ENABLED' AND l.source_system IN ('SAP','D365','SMS')

MIN(l.id) AS id,MAX(l.source_system) AS source_system,MAX(l.company_code) AS company_code,MAX(l.company_name) AS company_name,MAX(l.order_type) AS order_type,MAX(l.order_no) AS order_no,MAX(l.line_no) AS line_no,MAX(l.product_code) AS product_code
GROUP BY CAST(l.company_code AS BINARY),CAST(l.order_no AS BINARY),CAST(l.line_no AS BINARY),CAST(l.product_code AS BINARY) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id)=1
mapper.update:
UPDATE com_delivery_scope s
STRAIGHT_JOIN (SELECT ) matched ON matched.company_code=s.project_company_code AND matched.order_no=s.order_no AND matched.line_no=s.line_no AND matched.product_code=s.product_code AND CAST(matched.company_code AS BINARY)=CAST(s.project_company_code AS BINARY) AND CAST(matched.order_no AS BINARY)=CAST(s.order_no AS BINARY) AND CAST(matched.line_no AS BINARY)=CAST(s.line_no AS BINARY) AND CAST(matched.product_code AS BINARY)=CAST(s.product_code AS BINARY) SET s.order_line_id=matched.id,s.order_source_system=matched.source_system,s.order_company_code=matched.company_code,s.order_company_name=matched.company_name,s.order_type=matched.order_type,s.update_time=s.update_time WHERE s.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND s.order_line_id=-1 AND s.deleted=FALSE AND s.allocation_source='DPPMS' AND s.allocation_confirmed=FALSE
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM com_delivery_scope s WHERE s.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND s.order_line_id=-1 AND s.deleted=FALSE AND s.allocation_source='DPPMS'
mapper.update: CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE p22_allocation_new (scope_id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY,source_key VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,project_id BIGINT NULL,order_line_id BIGINT NULL,allocated_qty DECIMAL(18,6) NULL,allocation_version BIGINT NULL,project_company_code VARCHAR(64) NULL,order_source_system VARCHAR(32) NULL,order_company_code VARCHAR(64) NULL,order_type VARCHAR(32) NULL,order_no VARCHAR(64) NULL,line_no VARCHAR(32) NULL,product_code VARCHAR(64) NULL,KEY(order_line_id,project_id)) ENGINE=InnoDB

UPDATE p22_allocation_new n JOIN com_delivery_scope s ON s.id=n.scope_id AND s.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND s.deleted=FALSE AND s.allocation_confirmed=FALSE SET n.project_id=s.project_id,n.order_line_id=s.order_line_id,n.allocated_qty=s.allocated_qty,n.allocation_version=s.allocation_version,n.project_company_code=s.project_company_code,n.order_source_system=s.order_source_system,n.order_company_code=s.order_company_code,n.order_type=s.order_type,n.order_no=s.order_no,n.line_no=s.line_no,n.product_code=s.product_code

CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE p22_allocation_orders (id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY,order_qty DECIMAL(18,6) NULL,unit_scale INT NULL,source_system VARCHAR(32),company_code VARCHAR(64),order_type VARCHAR(32),order_no VARCHAR(64),line_no VARCHAR(32),product_code VARCHAR(64)) ENGINE=InnoDB
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO p22_allocation_orders(id,order_qty,unit_scale,source_system,company_code,order_type,order_no,line_no,product_code) SELECT DISTINCT l.id,l.order_qty,l.unit_scale,l.source_system,l.company_code,l.order_type,l.order_no,l.line_no,l.product_code AND l.source_lifecycle_status='ACTIVE' AND l.id IN (SELECT n.order_line_id FROM p22_allocation_new n WHERE n.order_line_id>0) FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE p22_allocation_occupied (order_line_id BIGINT NOT NULL,project_id BIGINT NOT NULL,allocated_qty DECIMAL(18,6) NOT NULL,KEY(order_line_id,project_id)) ENGINE=InnoDB
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO p22_allocation_occupied(order_line_id,project_id,allocated_qty) SELECT s.order_line_id,s.project_id,s.allocated_qty FROM com_delivery_scope s WHERE s.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND s.deleted=FALSE AND s.effective_to IS NULL AND s.allocation_confirmed=TRUE AND s.order_line_id IN (SELECT n.order_line_id FROM p22_allocation_new n WHERE n.order_line_id>0) FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE p22_allocation_totals (order_line_id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY,allocated_qty DECIMAL(28,6) NOT NULL) ENGINE=InnoDB
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO p22_allocation_totals SELECT order_line_id,SUM(allocated_qty) FROM p22_allocation_occupied GROUP BY order_line_id
mapper.update: CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE p22_allocation_pairs (order_line_id BIGINT NOT NULL,project_id BIGINT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(order_line_id,project_id)) ENGINE=InnoDB
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO p22_allocation_pairs SELECT DISTINCT order_line_id,project_id FROM p22_allocation_occupied
mapper.update: CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE p22_allocation_plan (scope_id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY,source_key VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,project_id BIGINT NOT NULL,order_line_id BIGINT NOT NULL,allocation_version BIGINT NOT NULL,decision VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,KEY(project_id,decision)) ENGINE=InnoDB
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO p22_allocation_plan(scope_id,source_key,project_id,order_line_id,allocation_version,decision) SELECT c.scope_id,c.source_key,c.project_id,c.order_line_id,c.allocation_version, CASE WHEN c.eligibility<>'CANDIDATE' THEN c.eligibility WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN c.eligibility='CANDIDATE' THEN c.allocated_qty ELSE 0 END) OVER(PARTITION BY c.order_line_id)+c.occupied_qty>c.order_qty THEN 'EXCESS' ELSE 'CONFIRMED' END FROM ( SELECT n.*,o.order_qty,COALESCE(occupied.allocated_qty,0) occupied_qty, CASE WHEN n.order_line_id<=0 OR o.id IS NULL OR o.order_qty IS NULL OR o.order_qty<=0 OR o.unit_scale IS NULL OR p.id IS NULL OR NOT (CAST(n.project_company_code AS BINARY) <=> CAST(o.company_code AS BINARY)) OR NOT (CAST(n.order_source_system AS BINARY) <=> CAST(o.source_system AS BINARY)) OR NOT (CAST(n.order_company_code AS BINARY) <=> CAST(o.company_code AS BINARY)) OR NOT (CAST(n.order_type AS BINARY) <=> CAST(o.order_type AS BINARY)) OR NOT (CAST(n.order_no AS BINARY) <=> CAST(o.order_no AS BINARY)) OR NOT (CAST(n.line_no AS BINARY) <=> CAST(o.line_no AS BINARY)) OR NOT (CAST(n.product_code AS BINARY) <=> CAST(o.product_code AS BINARY)) THEN 'PENDING' WHEN n.project_count>1 OR pair.order_line_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'DUPLICATE' WHEN ROUND(n.allocated_qty,o.unit_scale)<>n.allocated_qty THEN 'EXCESS' ELSE 'CANDIDATE' END eligibility FROM (SELECT a.*,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY a.project_id,a.order_line_id) project_count FROM p22_allocation_new a) n LEFT JOIN p22_allocation_orders o ON o.id=n.order_line_id LEFT JOIN p22_allocation_totals occupied ON occupied.order_line_id=n.order_line_id LEFT JOIN p22_allocation_pairs pair ON pair.order_line_id=n.order_line_id AND pair.project_id=n.project_id LEFT JOIN proj_project p ON p.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND p.id=n.project_id AND p.deleted=FALSE ) c
mapper.select: SELECT decision,COUNT(*) AS count FROM p22_allocation_plan GROUP BY decision ORDER BY decision

SELECT project_id,MIN(allocation_version) min_version,MAX(allocation_version) max_version FROM p22_allocation_plan WHERE decision='CONFIRMED' AND project_id>#{query.after} GROUP BY project_id ORDER BY project_id LIMIT #{query.limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE com_delivery_scope_project_version v JOIN (VALUES ROW(#{row.projectId},#{row.expectedVersion})) requested(project_id,expected_version) ON requested.project_id=v.project_id SET v.scope_version=v.scope_version+1,v.payload_version=v.payload_version+1,v.last_change_type='ASSIGNED',v.version=v.version+1,v.updater=#{query.actorId},v.update_time=#{query.at} WHERE v.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND v.deleted=FALSE AND v.scope_version=requested.expected_version
mapper.select: SELECT scope_id,source_key,order_line_id FROM p22_allocation_plan WHERE decision='CONFIRMED' AND scope_id>#{query.after} ORDER BY scope_id LIMIT #{query.limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE com_delivery_scope s JOIN (VALUES ROW(#{row.scopeId},#{row.orderLineId})) requested(scope_id,order_line_id) ON requested.scope_id=s.id AND requested.order_line_id=s.order_line_id SET s.allocation_confirmed=TRUE,s.update_time=s.update_time WHERE s.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND s.deleted=FALSE AND s.effective_to IS NULL AND s.allocation_source='DPPMS' AND s.allocation_confirmed=FALSE
